summary: The end state shows nodes 1, 2 and 5 counting 38 positions while index 36 is absent, which points to an accepted-index inflation that happened before the StopSign was placed at 37, but the receipt so far cannot show when that happened. This revision records, for every node, each transition of the accepted index together with whether a StopSign is present, tagged by action step or convergence round and capped at sixty entries, so the sequence that produced the hole and the marker placement becomes visible. A transition such as an accepted index rising by one with no StopSign present, followed by a marker appearing while the index rises again, would directly instantiate the sync_log inflation and the subsequent placement at the inflated position. The seeded 900-action schedule, reconfigure at action 450, 20 percent loss, 150-round convergence, node 3 ordered trace, node 4 promise diagnostics, is_reconfigured flags, entry kinds, extra-node indices, the p4_gap invariant and both declared comparisons are unchanged. The receipt should either pin the mechanism or show that the inflation happened outside the sampled points, in which case the existing limitation stands.
